notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32916102/3a67906a5931abb12913003962504fc607afc002.png[/img]

now, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/908040/TapSonic_World_Champion_VR_with_EOS/]EOS TAPSONIC VR(DLC)[/url] brings new precision to rhythm games in the blockchain.

EOS TAPSONIC VR, which attempts to gamify the experience of using the EOS blockchain, aiming to entertain and provide experience using blockchain driven VR applications.

Once logged into the Scatter and play the EOS TAPSONIC VR, players can check their results on EOS Mainnet.
